summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour discusses the critical importance of prayer (salah) in Islam, drawing on multiple hadith narrations that emphasize the severe consequences of abandoning prayer. He explains that prayer is the distinguishing factor between believers and disbelievers, citing the Prophet's warning that what separates a person from disbelief is maintaining salah. Sh. Ali Mashhour highlights the scholarly consensus on this matter, noting that the four Islamic schools of jurisprudence take abandoning prayer so seriously that some scholars debate whether someone who completely abandons prayer remains Muslim. He emphasizes that parents have a duty to instill the importance of prayer and the Quran in their children.
